item.title: Episode 004 with Zack Wyld of Wyld Productions
item.itunes:title: Episode 004 with Zack Wyld of Wyld Productions
item.description: In this episode, my guest is Brandon Cruz of Wyld Productions. Here the founder of Wyld and I speak up about bromances, creators, failing at art, and his alias - Zack Wyld. We touch on the importance and weirdness of alter egos and avatars for creators and artists, plus much more. A stunning photographer, videographer, and continuous creator - Brandon's work and vision on life always bring love and understanding to our meetups.
